summary: typescript, javascript npm package (Node server + Vite client). 7 criterion(s) need work: agents_md, lint_format, env_example, lockfile, templates, precommit, coverage.

criteria.notes: No lint or format tooling: no eslint/prettier/biome config is tracked, and package.json has no lint or format script. 193 .ts and 77 .mjs files (src/server, src/client, src/shared, src/client/iwsdk-scripts, bin/) are unchecked for style.
package.json "typecheck" runs tsc --noEmit on tsconfig.server.json and tsconfig.client.json (both extend strict tsconfig.base.json).
31 test files under tests/*.test.ts, run by node:test through tsx.
package.json "build" runs vite build (client) then tsc -p tsconfig.server.json (server into dist/server).
README.md "Development" section documents npm install, build, typecheck, test and running bin/agent-office.js; "dev" and "start" scripts exist.
No root AGENTS.md (and no CLAUDE.md to convert). Agent-critical facts live only in README.md, e.g. the rule to bump PTY_PROTOCOL in src/server/ptys.ts after changing src/server/ptyhost.ts.

README.md documents env vars (AGENT_OFFICE_PASSWORD, AGENT_OFFICE_BUDGET, AGENT_OFFICE_CITY, AGENT_OFFICE_VERSION, ...) and src/server/config.ts:192-210 reads about 12 more, but no .env.example exists.
.github/workflows/release.yml runs npm ci (its prepare script builds), npm run typecheck and npm test on PRs and main. No lint step, because no lint command exists yet.

measurement.command: npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm test

criteria.notes: GitHub-hosted (origin nikships/agent-office, upstream AgentSystemLabs/agent-office), but .github/ has only workflows/: no ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ and no pull_request_template.md.
Tests exist (31 files) but coverage is not measured or enforced: no --coverage flag in scripts, no c8/istanbul config, nothing in release.yml.
Root package.json has package-lock.json tracked, but the nested manifest src/client/package.json (devDependency @iwsdk/cli 1.0.0-rc.2) has no tracked lockfile.
Root .gitignore ignores node_modules and dist; no generated directories or env files are tracked.
